sourceReadbackMethod: gen_getContractCode; base64 decoded to UTF-8 bytes

readback.breach_rule: two distinct consecutive qualified negative captures
readback.contest_outage_recovery: one consensus-observed external capture failure may extend the effective contest deadline by a bounded 900 seconds; no semantic negative is created
readback.contest_rule: the promisor may request one fresh authenticated capture of the locked source; adjudication is bound to its immutable contest snapshot
readback.evidence_discovery: Wayback/CDX/Availability are optional off-chain research and recovery only
readback.name: Uphold
readback.redirect_behavior: gl.nondet.web exposes status and body here; final URL and headers are not assumed visible
readback.semantic_verification: independent validators classify the same authenticated baseline and live snapshot; only classification is consensus-critical
readback.settlement_confirmation: external Studio/client observation; no contract-level receipt is available
readback.source_claim: the wallet stakes behind the exact commitment text and locked HTTPS source; content authentication does not prove domain ownership or legal identity
